cap: Ovarian tumors are named for the normal cell they imitate. Surface epithelium of the ovary and fallopian tube gives most cancers in older women, germ cells give teratomas and marker-secreting tumors in young women, sex cord-stromal cells make hormones, and bilateral mucinous or signet-ring masses suggest metastasis from the gut.
teach: Use the columns as a sorting rule for any vignette: age points to a column, and the product narrows it to one box. A postmenopausal woman with ascites and CA-125 sits in the first column; a teenager with AFP or lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) sits in the second; a woman with new estrogen or androgen effects sits in the third.
